items.title: When can we say AI made a scientific discovery?
items.raw_text: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here. Last Wednesday, Anthropic announced that earlier this year it had launched a molecular biology lab, where Claude agents read and conjecture about hard biology problems and human scientists run experiments on what…
items.reason_zh: 探讨AI能否算作科学发现者这一根本性问题，结合Anthropic生物实验室案例，启发性强。
items.summary_zh: MIT Tech Review的The Algorithm newsletter讨论了“何时可以说AI做出了科学发现”这一核心问题。文章以Anthropic为例：该公司今年早些时候成立了一个分子生物学实验室，让Claude agent阅读并推测困难的生物学问题，再由人类科学家对推测进行实验验证。文章借此探讨AI在科研中的角色定位——是工具、合作者还是发现者，以及如何界定AI对科学发现的贡献。
items.title_zh: 我们何时能说AI做出了科学发现？

items.title: Apps, Agents, and Aggregation
items.raw_text: Agents are the ultimate Aggregators; they reveal apps as a means, not an ends, and providing them is tech's biggest prize.
items.reason_zh: Stratechery 从聚合理论视角剖析 agent 与 app 的关系，是理解 AI 时代入口之争的框架性文章。
items.summary_zh: Stratechery 的文章提出，agent 是终极形态的聚合器：它们把应用还原为实现目的的手段而非目的本身，从而揭示出应用层可能被重新中介化的趋势。作者沿用聚合理论的分析框架，讨论当用户通过 agent 而非直接打开 app 完成任务时，价值与议价权将如何从应用向 agent 层转移，以及为何提供 agent 能力被视为科技行业最大的奖赏。文章为理解 AI 时代的入口之争与平台格局演变提供了可迁移的分析视角。

items.title: Acoustic-to-Text KV Compression for Full-Duplex Speech Models
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.31224v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Full-duplex speech language models continuously accumulate acoustic key-value (KV) states, making long-running interactions memory-intensive. During listening, the model can finish processing an audio unit before the next arrives; we term the remaining interval listening-time slack. We propose acoustic-to-text KV compression, which introduces a transcription side channel to convert incoming speech into compact textual memory within this interval. When the cache exceeds a target budget during inference, older acoustic states are evicted while transcripts and recent acoustic context remain. We train the side channel with LoRA using cross-entropy on transcription segments. To preserve listening and speaking behavior, we apply knowledge distillation to the original model's token-level output distributions at native prediction positions. On ten-minute LongSpeech sessions, our MiniCPM-o 4.5 implementation reduces peak streaming KV-cache size
items.reason_zh: 针对全双工语音模型提出声学到文本的KV压缩，利用聆听间隙降低长时交互内存开销。
items.summary_zh: 全双工语音语言模型会持续累积声学键值（KV）状态，导致长时间交互内存开销巨大。作者观察到，在聆听阶段，模型可在下一音频单元到达前完成当前单元处理，并将剩余间隔称为聆听时间松弛。基于此，本文提出声学到文本的KV压缩方法，在松弛区间将声学KV状态转换为更紧凑的文本表示，从而显著降低内存占用。该方法为全双工语音模型的长时运行提供了高效的内存管理思路。
items.title_zh: 面向全双工语音模型的声学到文本KV压缩

items.title: Don't CLAP: Are Music-Text Models Bag-of-Words?
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.30540v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Text-to-music systems are assessed on audio quality and on how faithfully the music follows its prompt, and the CLAP score, the cosine similarity between a music-text model's audio and text embeddings, is the standard objective metric of faithfulness. We ask how accurately that score reflects the text: when an attribute is linked to an instrument (e.g., distorted guitar), does the text embedding capture that binding? To find out, we introduce an attribute swap perturbation: the caption of a real recording is edited by exchanging exactly one property, timbre, lead versus accompaniment, or order of first appearance, between two instruments. We then test four contrastive music-text models and one large audio-language model on whether the audio scores higher against the original caption than against the perturbed one. No contrastive model distinguishes the two captions reliably. The audio-language model does better, but further experiments
items.reason_zh: 质疑文本到音乐领域标准评测指标 CLAP 的有效性，揭示其词袋式缺陷，对评测方法设计有反直觉启发。
items.summary_zh: 文本到音乐系统通常以音频质量和音乐对提示词的遵循程度来评估，其中 CLAP 分数（音乐-文本模型音频与文本嵌入的余弦相似度）是衡量遵循度的标准客观指标。本文追问该分数在多大程度上真实反映文本语义：当某个属性与特定乐器相关联时，CLAP 是否能正确捕捉这种组合关系。研究发现 CLAP 类模型的行为近似词袋模型，对属性与乐器的绑定关系不敏感，从而质疑了当前文本到音乐评测体系的可靠性，并呼吁重新审视该指标的使用。
items.title_zh: 别用 CLAP：音乐-文本模型是词袋模型吗？

items.title: Symbiotic Architecture for Post-Hoc Audio Extension of Frozen Language Models
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.30784v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: This paper proposes an architecture for equipping large language models (LLMs) with audio-understanding capabilities without fine-tuning their weights. The proposed symbiotic architecture employs an injector module that writes audio-conditioned vectors directly into the target LLM's short-term memory, i.e., the key-value (KV) cache, enabling the LLM to behave as an audio language model (ALM). The architectural advantages are twofold. First, it improves the scalability of ALMs: because the proposed method bypasses the LLM during audio injection, the injection cost is governed by the injector width rather than the backbone width, and can therefore scale more slowly than the cost of full-backbone prefilling. Second, since the training scheme does not update the LLM weights, the original capabilities of the LLM are preserved without the risk of degradation from fine-tuning. items.reason_zh: 提出不改动 LLM 权重、直接向 KV 缓存注入音频向量的共生架构，为多模态扩展提供低成本新路径。
items.summary_zh: 本文提出一种共生架构，使大语言模型无需微调权重即可获得音频理解能力。该架构通过一个注入器模块，将音频条件向量直接写入目标 LLM 的短期记忆，即键值（KV）缓存中，从而让模型在推理时利用音频信息。这种方法避免了重新训练或微调带来的高昂成本，同时保留原模型的语言能力，为冻结语言模型的多模态扩展提供了一种轻量、可插拔的实现思路。
items.title_zh: 面向冻结语言模型事后音频扩展的共生架构

items.title: Fixed-weight models are adversarially vulnerable: hence misaligned
items.raw_text:
This post argues that fixed-weight models (at least as we understand them today) will a) always be vulnerable to adversarial examples in their concept-spaces, and b) hence will be misaligned, under sufficient optimisation pressure.

Boundaries in concept space

To serve any purpose whatsoever, an AI will have to draw boundaries inside its world-model - to distinguish world A from world B, and reach some comparison between them.

If we want the AI to follow our goals and values, we want it to be able to recognise concepts like "human being", or maybe "conscious being", "suffering", "preference satisfaction", "law",
items.reason_zh: 从对抗脆弱性推导固定权重模型必然失准，论证角度新颖，对AI对齐研究有启发。
items.summary_zh: 该文提出一个理论论证：固定权重模型（即当前主流模型形态）在其概念空间中必然存在对抗样本，因此在足够优化压力下将不可避免地出现失准（misalignment）。作者认为，只要模型权重在部署后固定不变，攻击者或优化过程就能找到使其行为偏离设计意图的输入，这并非工程缺陷而是结构性特征。文章由此推论，对齐问题不能仅靠训练阶段解决，需要重新思考模型架构或运行时机制。
items.title_zh: 固定权重模型在对抗下脆弱：因而必然失准

items.title: Implementing synthetic monitoring using Amazon Nova Act
items.raw_text: Learn an agent-driven approach to synthetic monitoring using Amazon Nova Act and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. The post covers the architecture and patterns for resilient, managed user-journey validation that moves beyond brittle UI scripts, with a complete sample implementation.
items.reason_zh: AWS官方博客，用Amazon Nova Act和Bedrock AgentCore实现agent驱动的合成监控，替代脆弱的UI脚本，含完整示例，工程实践价值高。
items.summary_zh: AWS官方博客介绍了一种基于agent的合成监控方案，使用Amazon Nova Act与Amazon Bedrock AgentCore构建。文章指出传统UI脚本式监控脆弱易失效，转而采用agent驱动的方式模拟真实用户旅程，实现更具韧性的托管式验证。内容涵盖整体架构设计、关键模式与实现要点，并提供了完整的示例代码，帮助开发者将合成监控从脚本维护转向agent编排，降低维护成本并提升对用户路径的覆盖能力。
items.title_zh: 使用 Amazon Nova Act 实现合成监控

items.reason_zh: IEEE Spectrum 深度报道生成式 AI 如何让航天器获得工程师曾不敢放手的自主决策能力，揭示太空场景下 AI 落地的真实工程取舍。
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨生成式 AI 正在让航天器获得前所未有的自主性，而这类自主决策曾是工程师因风险顾虑而刻意回避的。报道以 NASA 等机构的实践为线索，讲述太空任务中通信延迟、环境不确定性和人力遥操作瓶颈如何推动 AI 从辅助工具走向自主决策主体。文中还讨论了工程师对失控风险的担忧，以及如何通过可解释性、安全边界和人在回路机制来平衡自主与可控。太空正成为 AI 继地面之后的下一个前沿试验场。

items.title: 下一代搜索智能体评测基准！美团开源LoHoSearch，用知识图谱校准AI能力认知
items.raw_text: 过去一年，我们见证了 Search Agent 能力的显著演进。在 BrowseComp 等评测上，顶尖模型准确率从最初的 30% 区间迅速攀升至 90% 以上。然而，当基准迅速饱和，其区分模型能力的价值也随之递减。
items.reason_zh: 美团开源下一代搜索智能体评测基准 LoHoSearch，用知识图谱校准 AI 能力认知，针对 BrowseComp 等基准饱和问题提出新评测思路，值得评测研究者关注。
items.summary_zh: 美团开源下一代搜索智能体评测基准 LoHoSearch。文章指出，过去一年 Search Agent 能力显著演进，在 BrowseComp 等评测上顶尖模型准确率从最初的 30% 区间迅速攀升至 90% 以上。然而当基准迅速饱和，其区分模型能力的价值也随之递减。LoHoSearch 借助知识图谱来校准对 AI 能力的认知，旨在提供更具区分度与挑战性的搜索智能体评测方案，为下一代 Search Agent 的能力评估提供新基准。
items.title_zh: 下一代搜索智能体评测基准！美团开源LoHoSearch，用知识图谱校准AI能力认知

items.title: 美团智播——数字人直播技术创新与实践

items.reason_zh: 美团智播完整拆解数字人直播从真人复刻、动作生成到音画同步与万路并发推理加速的技术闭环，对做数字人与实时推理的工程师有可迁移的工程参考。
items.summary_zh: 美团技术团队分享其数字人直播产品“美团智播”的技术创新与实践。文章围绕 AI 主播“长得真→动得准→演得活→卖得好”四个维度构建完整技术闭环：通过真人 1:1 复刻实现换装换背景时身份不跑偏；让动作自然流畅，摆脱“木偶戏”感；做到边说边动、音画一致；并在底层通过推理加速技术支撑万路并发开播，使数字人直播的普惠落地成为可能。内容涵盖从形象生成、动作驱动到实时推理部署的完整工程链路。
